A_s / rme_J_ea0 for the two resonance lines are derived from the Carlsson et al. 1989 lifetimes after subtracting the weak 2P-2D branches with NIST A values (notes say 'derived'); all other A_s entries are CIPT theory from Dzuba et al. 2021 for the E2/M1 lines NIST does not list; no theory is entered for the 2P-2D E1 lines because NIST has measured A values. rme convention: A = 2.02613e18 |d|^2 / (lambda_vac[Angstrom]^3 (2J'+1)), J' the upper level. The two copper-vapour-laser lines are 3d10 4p 2P3/2 -> 3d9 4s2 2D5/2 (510.6 nm) and 2P1/2 -> 2D3/2 (578.2 nm); the E2 clock lines are 2S1/2-2D5/2 at 892.6 nm and 2S1/2-2D3/2 at 755.0 nm.
